title: Share what every oak looks like

task.text: A forest of a million trees builds a million identical textures.
Refactor so trees of the same species and colour **share** one object. `Forest.plant`, `size` and `draw` must return what they return now.

items: Move what is shared (species, colour, `Texture`) into `TreeType`.
Add `TreeTypes.of(String species, String color)`: the same arguments always give the same `TreeType` instance.
`Tree` keeps only its position and its `TreeType`.
`Forest` and `Tree` never call `new Texture` or `new TreeType`.

checks.title: Each tree keeps its own position
1000 trees of 3 kinds load at most 3 Textures
A second forest loads nothing new
Only the factory builds TreeType and Texture

hints.text: Split each tree's data into what is the same for every oak (species, colour, texture) and what is unique (x, y). Share the first part, keep the second per tree.
Create `TreeType` for the shared part and `TreeTypes.of` as a cache keyed by species and colour. `Tree` becomes x, y and a `TreeType`; `Forest.plant` asks the factory.
